notes.held_out: Selection uses the other worlds of the suite; V is from the held-out world. Worlds are not independent: the three SmolVLM cycles split one search run, branch worlds share nodes with the cycle worlds of the other suite, the qwen-compression chains are synthesized from a grid study, and the synthetic worlds are hand-made. Suites are analyzed separately, never pooled. Development worlds are excluded.
notes.in_sample: Selection and reported V use the same worlds.
notes.score: Eq. (1) replay score V; not LIBERO success.
notes.stage2_world: Committed 10-trial smoke measurements with the grid's parent->child edges; 'derived' bytes are a linear extrapolation, not a measurement.

world_provenance.qwen_compression_smoke: Study B grid distilled mildest->aggressive per family.
world_provenance.qwen_smoke_families: per-family splits of the smoke tree, families with >=4 nodes; single-branch worlds test stopping patience only.
world_provenance.qwen_stage2_smoke: committed 10-trial smoke run.json files on grid edges.
world_provenance.smolvlm_branches: per-root descendant subtrees with >=2 nodes; smaller roots pool per cycle into *-fragments worlds (split_cycle_branches).
world_provenance.smolvlm_cycles: attempts.jsonl grouped by root creation cycle (3 worlds).
